integrity: Proof uses the exact gcd-filtration theorem in the originating arXiv article; subsequent probabilistic argument is supplied. Finite recurrence checks are supporting evidence, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The invariant is the number of strict gcd drops in the canonical Stirling filtration; it is not asserted to equal the semigroup embedding dimension. No Gaussian convergence rate or exact law of the bounded discrepancy is proved. Independent priority comparison is absent.
title: Gaussian fluctuations of active gcd layers in Stirling numerical semigroups
